_llm_instructions: Populate the fields of 'DURATION ESTIMATES' and write the value of each field under 'Generated Value', based on the project context. Context: the project carrying reference PMO-04.03.06.

f01_Activity_Identifier_and_Description.label: Activity Identifier and Description
f01_Activity_Identifier_and_Description.guidance: The activity code and concise work summary for each estimated activity.

f02_Estimation_Method_Applied.label: Estimation Method Applied
f02_Estimation_Method_Applied.guidance: The specific technique used (analogous, parametric, three-point, or bottom-up).

f03_Estimated_Effort_Hours_and_Assigned_.label: Estimated Effort Hours and Assigned Resources
f03_Estimated_Effort_Hours_and_Assigned_.guidance: Total calculated person-hours of effort and assigned resource quantities.

f04_Estimated_Duration.label: Estimated Duration
f04_Estimated_Duration.guidance: Calculated working duration in work days or weeks required to complete the activity.

f05_Historical_Data_and_Productivity_Rat.label: Historical Data and Productivity Rates
f05_Historical_Data_and_Productivity_Rat.guidance: Empirical reference data, productivity metrics, and historical benchmarks used.

f06_Key_Estimating_Assumptions.label: Key Estimating Assumptions
f06_Key_Estimating_Assumptions.guidance: Foundational assumptions regarding resource availability, skill proficiencies, and work shifts.

f07_Schedule_Contingency_Reserve.label: Schedule Contingency Reserve
f07_Schedule_Contingency_Reserve.guidance: Calculated contingency buffer allocated to accommodate identified activity risks.

f08_Total_Activity_Duration_with_Conting.label: Total Activity Duration with Contingency
f08_Total_Activity_Duration_with_Conting.guidance: Final baseline duration inclusive of contingency buffer used in the schedule model.
